result.reason: The redline includes the required professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, 12-month software conformance warranty, repair/re-performance/replacement/refund remedies, legal-compliance warranty, and malicious-code warranty. However, it does not state the required 90-day duration for the services warranty. It also unnecessarily extends conformance beyond Documentation to “Specifications” and leaves the services warranty without an express temporal limit. The language otherwise preserves the disclaimer subject to the new express warranties and is professionally drafted.
